FOREWORD This Indian Standaid was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 5 June 1989, after the draft finalized by the Dye Intermediates Sectional Committee had been approved by the Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division Council. Naphthol AS-D [ 3-hydroxy-N-( 2-methyl phenol )-2-naphthalene-carboxamide J is used asa an azoic coupling component.
